_readme: THE song list (10 Nov 2026). One entry per release page (badscandal.com/<slug>). Read by the song pages (button link on release day), /admin, the visit counter, the Meta Conversions API and the edge function. Add a song with: node tools/new-song.mjs <slug> "<Title>" <YYYY-MM-DD>. On release day paste the track link into spotifyTrack and run: node tools/new-song.mjs --rebuild. Covers and share images are made by the tool; never reuse an asset filename (assets are cached for a year). No pre-save links, ever.
